note: Grimsby's world as his brain knows it: places, where they are (metres on the island, x = east, z = south; taken from SPOTS in island.js by world/build_spots.mjs --places) and what can happen there. The brain never sees the 3D; `obj` and `category` are only for the site. `feel` is how a place affects his mood (hidden from him; his beliefs have to find it out). `food` is what he can find at an eating place (words only).
